hint.portal: From the Developer Portal (Your Clients). Google reCAPTCHA must be disabled there.
hint.redirectUri: Copy and paste it from the portal, do not retype it – it must match exactly. Nothing has to listen at this address; the node reads the code directly from the Viessmann response.
hint.codeChallenge: 43 to 128 characters from letters, digits and - . _ ~. If left empty, the node generates a fresh one for every login.
hint.account: The same credentials as in the ViCare app.

runtime.notDeployed: Configuration not saved yet. Please press Deploy once.

errors.NO_CREDENTIALS: Credentials incomplete. Please enter the client ID, ViCare username, and password.
errors.BAD_CODE_CHALLENGE: Invalid code challenge: 43 to 128 characters from letters, digits and "-._~" are allowed. Leave the field empty to have one generated automatically.
errors.LOGIN_REJECTED: Login rejected (HTTP 401): ViCare username or password is incorrect.
errors.REDIRECT_URI_MISMATCH: Viessmann rejects the redirect URI (__detail__). Sent: "__redirectUri__". It must exactly match one of the addresses stored for the client in the Viessmann Developer Portal (http/https, host name, port, path and trailing slash).
errors.INTERACTIVE_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Viessmann requires an interactive login. Most common causes: Google reCAPTCHA is still enabled for this client in the Viessmann Developer Portal, the username or password is incorrect, or the redirect URI "__redirectUri__" does not match the one stored there.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: Viessmann API rate limit reached (HTTP 429). Increase the polling interval.
errors.NO_INSTALLATION: No installation found. Is the system registered in the ViCare app?
errors.NO_GATEWAY: No gateway found (is the Vitoconnect online?).
